policy.name: Users can upload permitted payment proofs
policy.with_check:
((bucket_id = 'payment-proofs'::text) AND ((((storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'personal'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[2] = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)) OR (((storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'families'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[4] = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.families
  WHERE ((families.id = ((storage.foldername(families.name))[2])::uuid) AND ((families.owner_id)::text = (storage.foldername(families.name))[3]) AND public.is_active_family_participant(families.id)))))))
